As our study into alien life forms continues, it has recently been discovered that alien craft is using a type of cloaking technology codenamed "Alien Nebula". This is what it looks like.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint could be received as a reward for completing the challenges of the challenge (07/02/2019 - 07/31/2019) with a battle pass.
Though the artist for this paint was unable to match the record shortcut distance of 12 parsecs, she did plunge through a strange nebula while flying the Kessel Run and was inspired by the experience to create this texture.
